g.text: Measured. The aggregation tool cannot answer this question directly (no per-merchant totals, no weekday information); Code Mode has no aggregation

g.text: tool either. Each panel has its own y axis; latency is p50 wall-clock time excluding client-side throttling. MCP + aggregation tool: 9/10 cut off at
